thread:
alex_chu: Heads up — ACME HW wants to sync on marketplace listing requirements before our joint announcement. They asked what exact SOC/pen-test artifacts we need and how to upload them.

maria_garcia: do we have a checklist we can share? I can draft a one-pager for partners.

sam_irwin: short answer: SOC2 report (pdf), pen-test report (redacted), questionnaire answers, presigned S3 for artifacts, attestation statement for firmware if HW.

nidhi_patel: firmware attestation is separate. For HW partners we ask for:
- firmware attestation doc
- mitigations list
- signed attestation from device vendor

jamal_bryce: timeline? marketing wants the joint blog + marketplace tile by Apr 15.

alex_chu: @maria_garcia can you own the partner-facing checklist? @sam_irwin can you confirm what level of redaction is acceptable for pen tests? 

maria_garcia: yep I can own it. I'll draft and post by EOD tomorrow.

sam_irwin: pen tests: redact PII, creds, and any vuln PoC that'd enable exploit. Keep proof-of-fix snippets high-level. We accept an appendix with hashes for verification.

alex_chu: partner_ops_bot: create upload bucket with 7d presigned links and restrict to partner account.

partner_ops_bot: got it — provisioning presigned bucket for acme-hw-partner. ETA 1 business day. :gear:

nidhi_patel: note — marketplace requires signed attestation for supply chain controls for HW. We need signature + cert chain.

jamal_bryce: ok marketing deadline Apr 15. That means we need final artifacts by Apr 1 to allow legal + security review.

maria_garcia: I'll add a 'must-have by' column in the checklist. Draft will include upload steps + redaction examples + contact points.

sam_irwin: quick presign example for partners:
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://rw-marketplace/acme-hw/pen-test.pdf --expires-in 604800
```

alex_chu: action items:
- maria_garcia: partner checklist (due TOM)
- sam_irwin: redaction guidance + sample text (due 48h)
- nidhi_patel: attestation template for HW (due 3 days)
- partner_ops_bot: presign bucket (ETA 1d)

maria_garcia: will CC legal on the checklist.

jamal_bryce: thanks all. If partners can meet Apr 1 we can hit Apr 15 announcement.

alex_chu: I'll follow up with ACME to confirm they can meet Apr 1. If not, plan B is soft-launch in marketplace only and delay blog.

sam_irwin: also flagged: if pen-test is older than 12 months we require re-scan or a signed gap assessment.

nidhi_patel: noted — will add to checklist.

maria_garcia: linking the draft here when ready — expect by EOD.

partner_ops_bot: reminder set: checklist review meeting scheduled Thu 10:00am PT. Invite sent.

alex_chu: perfect, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
